about_the_game:
◆ Synopsis
Forbidden Research.
A study forever banned in Eden, never to be touched.

But when someone dares to resurrect it,
Officer Nazel begins his pursuit of the culprit...

The one behind it all is none other than his half-brother, Hazard.
Leaving his confusion behind, Nazel sets off to chase his brother.
However, he soon finds himself entangled in an irreversible fate.

◆ About the Game
CODE: Antithesis is a single-player game combining story-driven action-adventure gameplay with visual novel elements.

This demo includes the prologue and Chapter 1, offering approximately 3 to 5 hours of gameplay. It is currently available in Korean only.

1) Immersive Storyline
Uncover the hidden truths of a world bound by forbidden research.

2) NPC Interaction
Listen not only to the case but also to the heartfelt stories of your colleagues.
Before you know it, you'll come to understand their choices and beliefs.

3) Puzzles and Combat
Gather clues, solve puzzles, and subdue the culprit.

4) Adventure
Investigate crime scenes and explore various locations in Eden.
Help your colleagues and navigate the institution easily through the map.
